title: 宇树科技IPO：散户认购超5000倍，实际认购倍数为何更高？
speaker: Jesse Liu

segments.en: Futures are up this morning. Well, the World Robot Conference in Beijing starts this week on a growing investor appetite for physical AI companies.
segments.zh: 今早期货走高。本周北京世界机器人大会开幕，市场对实体AI公司的兴趣日益浓厚。

segments.en: And to this point, at that point, we see the retail section, meanwhile, of unit trees, upcoming IPO in Shanghai, more than 5,000 times, subscribe.
segments.zh: 与此同时，宇树科技即将在上海上市，散户认购倍数超过5000倍。

segments.en: Let's bring in one of the participants of this week's conference, Linux Dynamics or CFO Jesse Liu joins us. And welcome back to the program, Jesse. It's always great to have you. Tell us just about the conference itself. And really, what do you think is going to be the big theme this year? And how's it different from previous years?
segments.zh: 我们请来本周大会的参与者之一——宇树科技CFO Jesse Liu。欢迎再次来到节目。请谈谈这次大会，你认为今年的主题是什么？与往年有何不同？

segments.en: Yeah, it gets better every year, obviously. It's going to be very exciting this year. I predict, I can only predict, a lot of demos around open world environments, manipulation tasks, operating in sort of unstructured, open world environments, small living rooms, small kitchens. It's going to be the theme this year. It's going to be a big step up from last year where it's more structured, more sort of pre-organized, pre-rehearsed, right?
segments.zh: 每年都在进步，今年会非常精彩。我预测会有很多关于开放世界环境、操作任务的演示，在非结构化环境中，比如小客厅、小厨房。这将是今年的主题，相比去年是很大的提升，去年更多是结构化、预演好的。

segments.en: So looking forward to that. And I think something else is going to be new configurations of hardware, potentially. Hardware that's more optimized for specific use cases, specific tasks, and less sort of more generalize the traditional human noise that you see. Right.
segments.zh: 期待这些。另外可能还有新的硬件配置，更针对特定场景和任务优化，而不是通用的传统人形机器人。

segments.en: And your product lineup, how is that? So what are you looking to display? What's new from you guys? And how has that changed since the last time? Both of those are going to be on display at our booth in Halsey of WRC. Yes, yeah. 316. Yeah, 316. Yeah. C3, I was still going to introduce it. It's Hal 316. That's the plug for you. OK, go.
segments.zh: 你们的产品线如何？打算展示什么？有什么新东西？与上次相比有何变化？这些都会在我们的展位展出，在WRC的Halsey，316号展位。
